GOVERNMENT OF PUNJAB
DEPARTMENT OF WATER RESOURCES
NOTIFICATION
The 13th June, 2024
No.WR-IRWR04/37/2023-IW3/2169.- In exercise of the powers conferred by section 55
of the Northern India Canal and Drainage Act with Section 3 of the aforesaid Act, The Governor of Punjab is
pleased to notify the Khasra numbers as per details given below for smooth flow of water in “Nabha Drain RD
0-85500”. The Governor of Punjab is further pleased to authorize the Executive Engineer, Patiala, Drainage-
cum-Mining and Geology Division, WRD, Punjab, District, Patiala/Sangrur, to take all necessary action to
remove obstructions, in case obstructions are raised by any person. The concerned officer i.e. Executive Engineer,
Patiala, Drainage-cum-Mining and Geology Division, WRD, Punjab, District, Patiala/Sangrur, may also authorize
any other government officer or any private person to remove such obstructions or carry out any activities for
the aforesaid purpose.
